name: Food Delivery System (Go + PostgreSQL + Next.js + Docker + Redis)
description: A production-oriented food delivery platform designed to connect customers, restaurant owners, delivery drivers, and system administrators. The application allows customers to discover restaurants, browse menus, place orders, make payments, and track deliveries. Restaurant owners can manage their restaurants, menus, and orders, while delivery drivers can manage assigned deliveries and update order statuses.

name: Shortly URL Shortener (Express + PostgreSQL + Next.js)
description: I built this as a complete, production-style example of a small backend service: a REST API with real authentication, a normalized PostgreSQL schema, rate limiting, and a thin Next.js frontend that consumes the API like any other client would. There's no ORM magic hiding what's going on — the data layer is plain SQL through pg, so it's easy to read exactly what every endpoint does to the database.

name: Pimpcom E-Commerce (Next.js + NestJS + PostgreSQL)
description: storefront (home, product listing, product detail, cart, checkout, order history) and a full admin panel (dashboard, products CRUD, categories CRUD, order management, user management)

name: Yamli Social Media App (Node.js + Express + MYSQL + Vue.js)
description: A full-stack social media application built using Node.js, Express, MYSQL, and Vue.js. This app allows users to register, log in, create posts (text/images), like and comment, follow/unfollow users, and more..
